name: count-up
title: Count up
description: A number that counts up from zero the first time it is mostly on screen, with prefix, suffix, decimals and locale, and the final value in the page from the start.
docs: The final value is in the page from the first render, in text for screen readers, search engines and print; the visible digits sit in a box as wide as that value, so nothing shifts while they run. It counts when 40 percent of the number is on screen. A number that is already on screen when the page hydrates keeps its final value, one that mounts in the browser always counts. Reduced motion and browsers without IntersectionObserver show the final value at once. Pass your application locale.
